niche-scary.label: Scary story
niche-scary.typed: The lighthouse had been empty for forty years. So who kept writing in the logbook? Last night, the light came back on.

niche-history.label: History
niche-history.typed: The Great Pyramid was the tallest building on Earth for almost four thousand years. Nothing built by people stood taller until the 1300s.

niche-motivation.label: Motivation
niche-motivation.typed: Nobody sees the mornings you show up. They only see the day it pays off. Show up anyway.

niche-mythology.label: Mythology
niche-mythology.typed: Icarus was told: not too low, not too high. He flew toward the sun anyway. The sea kept only his feathers.

niche-trivia.label: Trivia
niche-trivia.typed: An octopus has three hearts. And its blood is blue. Follow for one strange fact a day.

niche-fable.label: Fable
niche-fable.typed: The hare laughed at the slow tortoise. Halfway there, the hare took a nap. Slow and steady still wins.
